shortDescription: Rajasthan Police Sub Inspector SI 2021 re-exam admit card 2026 is now available. Download the Rajasthan Police SI admit card for the revised schedule.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Sub Inspector SI 2021 re-exam admit card 2026 for the revised examination schedule.

Eligible candidates can download the admit card from the official RPSC or SSO portal by logging in with their registration details.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 09 February 2021
  • Last date to apply online: 23 June 2021
  • Written exam date: 13-15 September 2021
  • Re-exam date: 20 September 2026
  • Exam city details: 13 September 2026
  • Admit card available: 17 September 2026

Vacancy details

Total vacancies: 857 posts

  • Sub Inspector AP: 663
  • Sub Inspector IB: 64
  • Platoon Commander: 38
  • Sub Inspector MBC: 11

Download the admit card and carry it along with a valid photo ID to the examination centre.
